_comment: Google Calendar bridge config. PUSH: the catalyst calendar (tools/monitorclt_catalyst) already answers 'which parcels have a meaningful catalyst in the next 60 days?' -- this puts those dates on the calendar acquisitions actually looks at, as all-day events keyed by APN so a re-run updates in place instead of duplicating. PULL: dates you learn away from the desk (a hearing announced at a REIA meeting, a maturity a broker mentions) get typed straight into the calendar; we read them back as EXPLICIT catalyst rows and feed them to catalyst.py, which always prefers an explicit date over a derived offset. inbound_aliases map the words you would actually type in an event title to the catalyst vocabulary in catalyst_rules.json.

colors._comment: Google Calendar colorId per urgency band; 11 red, 6 orange, 5 yellow, 8 grey.
